p: rest of the children of Manasseh: For the other half tribe had their portion beyond Jordan.
brethren: Among them of our tribe.
Manasseh: In the land of canaan: five to the males: and other five to the daughters of Zelophehad.
Tappuah on the border of Manasseh: Meaning, the city itself.
sea: That is, toward the main sea.
Asher on the north: In the tribe of Asher, and tribe of Issachar.
could not drive out the inhabitants: For at first they lacked courage, and later agreed with them on condition, contrary to God's commandment.
blessed me hitherto: According to my father Jacob's prophecy, Ge 48:19.
if mount Ephraim be too narrow: If this mount is not large enough, why do you not get more by destroying God's enemies, as he has commanded.
for thou shalt drive out the: So that you shall enlarge your portion by it.
